caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate candlestick or goblet-like object centrally placed on a plain, light beige background. The object is rendered in shades of blue and aqua, showing a transparent or glass-like texture. It has a wide, flat, circular base that supports a tall, slender stem, which curves outward and inward in a series of rounded bulges and rings. The central portion of the stem features a globular segment with a spiral or twisted pattern, followed by a gently flaring upper section that ends in a wide, open rim. The entire object has a smooth, reflective surface, and the overall style suggests careful attention to the depiction of transparency and light reflection, typical of glassware illustration. The signature "N. Amantea" appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
